req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-018 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI documentation with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — exact status code 200 (not 201, not 199) and exact Content-Type header containing 'text/html'; (4) DT — verifying the response body contains the specific Swagger UI script tag and title metadata from the FastAPI app configuration. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact content-type substrings, and exact HTML body markers that would fail if the route were removed, redirected, or returned wrong content.

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200_with_html
preconditions: GET /docs endpoint is registered by FastAPI automatically
trace: R-PLAYER-018: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
EP: nominal request to /docs falls in the valid equivalence partition
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_returns_200_with_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert 'text/html' in response.headers['content-type']
    assert len(response.content) > 0

test_get_docs_returns_200_with_html()

tests.name: test_get_docs_body_contains_swagger_ui_markers
preconditions: FastAPI app is instantiated in-process with title 'python-samples-fastapi-restful'
GET /docs endpoint is registered by FastAPI automatically
actions: Inspect response body for Swagger UI HTML markers
trace: R-PLAYER-018: expected payload is interactive Swagger UI documentation
DT: both Swagger UI CSS/JS markers must be present for the UI to be interactive
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_body_contains_swagger_ui_markers():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.text
    assert 'swagger-ui' in body
    assert 'SwaggerUIBundle' in body

test_get_docs_body_contains_swagger_ui_markers()
